text: The model flagged three points that moved the risk score in opposite directions. Having three real‑estate loans or mortgages added +0.258 to the default‑risk estimate, meaning the model views a larger mortgage portfolio as a factor that raises the chance of default. Being 43 years old contributed +0.182, which the model interprets as a modest increase in risk for that age group. Conversely, the applicant has no 30‑ to 59‑day past‑due accounts, which contributed ‑0.152, pulling the risk estimate down because a clean recent payment history lowers default likelihood. These opposing influences together resulted in the overall “low‑risk” decision despite the individual risk‑raising factors.
